Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly classified Da Nang as part of the "Southern Vietnam (Miền Nam / Nam Trung Bộ)" region. Da Nang is actually located in the South Central Coast region (Nam Trung Bộ), which is part of Central Vietnam (Miền Trung), not Southern Vietnam. This misclassification led to the incorrect final answer. The WebSurfer agent correctly identified the location of the Zone 5 Military Museum as Da Nang, but the Planner's misunderstanding of the regional classification caused the error.
